programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate Fort Ontario, a place that was the only location in America to provide sanctuary for Jewish refugees during World War II. Built in 1755, this fort first saw battle during the French and Indian war, and is no stranger to bloodshed. ...and phenomena.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Baton Rouge, Louisiana to investigate the Old State Capital Building. Built in 1852, this building has seen countless politicians come through its doors including congressman, Pierre Couvillon, who died during a heated debate opposing gambling. The building also survived the Civil War, during which the Union Army used the basement as a prison.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Joliet, Illinois to investigate that Rialto Square Theater. In the 1920's the Rialto Square Theater hosted famous entertainers and vaudeville stars. But in the 1930's an accident took place right outside the theater where a little boy was hit by a car and then later dies inside. People in the theater have since claimed to see the little boy, who they named Kevin, and experienced other eerie paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Claremont, New Hampshire to investigate a former shoe and furniture factory, the Topstone Mill. What was once an abandoned space has now become a restaurant and bar... with frequent visitors from "the other side." Could deceased workers from the 1900's be trying to contact a mother and son team who own the bar? TAPS has surprising evidence that could point in that direction.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lockport, New York to investigate an underworld of tunnels. It holds a mystery of possible murders, multiple deaths and frightening phenomena. What stories do the spirits of Lockport Caves want to tell? Will TAPS be able to reassure their client that visitors will be safe if they venture on one of the longest underground boat rides in America? Next up, the team travels to Skaneateles, New York to investigate the Fuller House.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hampton Falls, New Hampshire to investigate the Governor's Mansion, a property Steve has investigated before with a local team. Could this estate's hauntings be connected to a sad secret surrounding a little boy who is believed to have once lived here in the late 1800's? Will TAPS be able to reach this child and find out if he was in fact the hidden legitimate son of State Senator, Warren Brown? Could the State Senator have been behind his murder?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Gloucester, Massachusetts to investigate Hammond Castle. They are joined by Josh Gates to find out if the original owners and paranormal pioneers, John and Irene Hammond haunt their property. Are the Hammonds able to talk to the living, as they once were able to do with the dead? What does a disembodied voice say that leads TAPS to believe the Hammonds might still be here?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Bowling Green, Kentucky to investigate Western Kentucky University. This University was established in 1906 and has 20,000 students attending. Tamela Smith is the client, and has called TAPS in to figure out if some of the stories that have been passed down over the decades are folklore or truth. There are three main stories that surround the school.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Rochester, New York to investigate the Rochester Public Library's 15 years of claims. There's reason to believe that two deaths associated with the building could be behind the activity. The library wants to go public with the phenomena but only if accurate. Can TAPS find the answer they are looking for and finally let the public in on this library's long-held secret?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS returns to Hartford, Connecticut to investigate the Mark Twain House. With their previous investigation marred by malfunctioning equipment, TAPS is being called back to look into new and frightening claims that could finally uncover who is residing there. Will Samuel Clemens' favorite holiday initiate an appearance from the famous author? Or will his three children try to reach out to TAPS?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hollywood, California to investigate the infamous Black Dahlia murder at the historic Sowden House. Aspiring actress, Elizabeth Short was nicknamed the Black Dahlia after her brutal murder and the leading suspect of that horrific crime was never convicted. Two people have called in TAPS; the first being the main murder suspects own son, Steve Hodel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to San Juan Capistrano, California to investigate the San Juan Capistrano Mission. This mission has been in the community for 236 years dating back to the Spanish Colonial. An earthquake in 1812 buried 40 people in the rubble; including a teen age girl named Magdalena. The legend goes that she was dating a boy her father disapproved of, and had to do penance at the alter. As she walked up to confess, the earthquake began and she was buried alive.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Bartonville, Illinois, to investigate Peoria Asylum. The owners are renovating this building and have noticed a lot of paranormal activity since they started their restorations. Built in 1898 and opened in 1902, it is said that 16,000 people died there, from multiple reasons, including, patients killing patients and suicide. The asylum's records hold two key figures; Dr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cortland, New York to investigate The 1890 House. Industrialist, Chester Wickwire built this home for his family, and even though they have long passed, it's believed by some that the family may still reside here. Michelle, the caretaker, is concerned that the spirits may follow her home. Do the Wickwire's still live in their former home and if so, can TAPS help put Michelle's mind at ease that they mean her no harm?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the oldest operating steamboat in the United States. The boat was built in 1914 and has been used for everything from dances to gambling. Its former Captain Winters was legendary for being somewhat shady. It's claimed that he killed a deckhand named Floyd during an argument when he sent him to do work on the paddle wheel and then ordered full steam ahead, which killed Floyd.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Coventry, Connecticut to investigate the Nathan Hale Homestead. Nathan Hale was an American Patriot who fought in the Revolutionary War and was executed by hanging by the British for being a spy. He was left outside hanging for days to send a message. He was then dumped in an unmarked grave. Now our client, Bev, believes he has come back to his childhood home. His house was built in 1776 and in the 1940's was turned into a museum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Sylvan Beach Park in Sylvan Beach, New York to investigate a theme park originally built in the 1890's. Sylvan Beach Park used to be referred to as the Coney Island of Central New York, with its famous hotels, lakeside attractions, and amusement rides. Now Sylvan Beach holds a haunted history and TAPS has been asked to investigate, much to the unease of some of the employees who fear the investigation will agitate the spirits further.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate the Shreveport Auditorium, a place that is famous for introducing Elvis to the world. Shreveport Auditorium opened in 1929 and is considered a national landmark. The auditorium's stage has been graced by such stars as Hank Williams and Johnny Cash and is known as the first place Elvis preformed professionally. A statue of Elvis was erected after he passed and that's when the phenomena is said to have begun.
programme.sub-title: The Ghost Hasn't Left the Building

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Little Rock, Arkansas to investigate a personal case at the Jones House and their bungalow next door. Robberies, fires, assault, and murder have all taken place in the old bungalow, dating back to 1898, when Ed Cornish had his wife and two children die 16 hours apart. Then in 2005 Bonnie Wallace, the Jones' neighbor, was murdered by an acquaintance in the bungalow and her husband, Paul died shortly after from illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Liberty, Missouri to investigate the Belvoir Winery; a property that has four buildings that are being renovated to become a retirement facility and winery. These buildings were at one time an orphanage, an old folks home, a hospital, and a nursing home and have seen over 10,000 deaths through the years.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In 1931, Boulder City was built to accommodate the thousands of Hoover Dam workers and their families who inundated the area. Around the same time, the Boulder City Hospital was constructed mainly to care for the injured and dying Hoover Dam workers. Because of dangerous working conditions and hardships, over 100 men died building the Dam, with many of them ending up at the Boulder City Hospital.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Elms Resort & Spa in Excelsior Springs, Missouri was built in the 1880's to accommodate the thousands of visitors flocking to the area, which had rapidly gained a reputation of having mineral springs with magical healing powers. The first Elms Resort was opened in 1888 and burned down in 1898. They opened a new hotel in 1912 (which has recently been renovated).

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Monticello, Arkansas to investigate The Allen Mansion, built in 1906 by a wealthy businessman named Joe Allen. He lived there with his wife and three daughters. One of Joe Allen's daughters, Ladell is believed to have committed suicide in the mansion at the age of 54 years because of her divorce and later losing her son to pneumonia.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate two buildings that may share the same paranormal activity. The client, Grayson owns the 1800's era Rendall Building, which is across the street from the second building with activity, the Caddo Parish Courthouse. They are thought to be connected because it's believed that the The Rendall building's basement once acted as a cold storage facility for those who were hanged at the Courthouse.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Scott Township, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennsylvania Asylum and Testing Lab. This building was originally used as a poor house in the late 1800's and became a mental institution in 1915, followed by an animal testing facility. TAPS will have their hands full as they take on claims of threatening shadows and people being physically accosted.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hyde Hall in Cooperstown, NY to investigate a cursed family home. George Clark started building Hyde Hall in 1817 with the intension of it being a showplace for Clarke's agricultural empire and to remind him of his childhood in England. George died in 1835 on the southern porch before completion and his son, George Jr., took over the property. This was followed by a contentious relationship between George Jr. and his mother.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In 1863, the Battle of Gettysburg spanned 3 days and was the bloodiest conflict of the Civil War. 97,000 Union Soldiers and 75,000 Confederate Soldiers fought resulting in 51,000 casualties and one civilian fatality in a town that normally only has a population of 2,400. On the 150th Anniversary of the Battle, TAPS is called to Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, by one of Jason's good friends, Mark Nesbitt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Buffalo Naval and Military Park has called upon TAPS to investigate three vessels that all saw gunfire and bloodshed during their time of service. The ships that will be investigated are a cruiser named USS Little Rock (the largest), a destroyer named USS The Sullivans, and a submarine named USS Croaker, (the smallest). USS Little Rock has reported deaths on it.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Octagon Hall was built by Andrew Jackson Caldwell in 1847. Andrew and his wife, Elizabeth helped Confederate Soldiers during the Civil War by setting up a hospital room, where many of the soldiers died. They also built tunnels and passageways where the Confederate Soldiers could hide from the Union Soldiers. Andrew's wife and son died of Typhoid Fever during the war and his daughter, Mary Elizabeth, died when her dress caught on fire in the kitchen and she burned to death.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has been called to Lucas, Ohio by playwright Mark Jordan to investigate the property on which one of the most gruesome events took place in 1896, The Ceely Rose Murders. Ceely killed her father, brother and lastly, her mother with rat poison because she believed they were keeping her from the love of her life, Guy Berry. Ceely was 23 years at the time, but had a mental capacity of an 8 year old. Mark wrote a play about these murders, which he performs in a barn on the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Belle Grove Plantation sits in King George, Virginia. It is now a bed and breakfast, but the plantation played an important role in American History. James Madison, the 4th president, was born here, and John Wilkes Booth crossed through the property after he assassinated President Lincoln. The armed contingent searching for Booth stayed at Belle Grove Plantation the night before they caught and killed him.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home as they investigate the Cumberland Library & Monastery in Cumberland, Rhode Island. A massacre that occurred in the spring of 1676 may have been the first of several events to cause the paranormal activity that exists today.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to Brunswick, Georgia to investigate Brunswick Old City Hall. Chief Tobe Green has asked the team to investigate reports of paranormal activity that has gone on for years. Construction began in 1889 and by 1890 the top floor was used as the municipal court. In 1890, Officer Robert L. Massey was shot and killed here while trying to arrest a man who was found guilty for a minor offense. Unexplained activity has been reported ever since.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates the abandoned Elizabeth V. Edwards Elementary School in Barnegat, New Jersey. Built in 1930, this was first Barnegat High School until a larger one was built in 1957, turning this into an elementary school. In 1975 the school was renamed Elizabeth V. Edwards. Elizabeth was someone who dedicated her entire life to the education of Barnegat's young people. She passed away in 1965. The school was shut down in 2004.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Client, Rebecca Jordan Gleason has called TAPS back to Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum, in Weston, West Virginia, at a time when they are celebrating their 150th anniversary and Ghost Hunters, their 200th episode. TAPS was here in 2008 and found great evidence. Their parting words to Rebecca were for her to not do anything to stir up more paranormal activity...but that advice was not heeded and the activity has increased.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The prestigious Cincinnati Music Hall has welcomed famous composers and entertainers ranging from Igor Stravinsky and Richard Straus to Ella Fitzgerald and Bruce Springsteen. But it's the "the dead" that have shined a light on this historical building. In 1878 the central hall was first constructed and a year later the north and south halls were added to accommodate the industrial exhibitions that were so popular at the time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates five different locations along one of the most haunted streets in America! Main Street in St. Charles, Missouri was built on top of a cemetery, which at one time housed hundreds of bodies. As St. Charles grew, it became inconvenient to have a cemetery in the middle of the city and in 1850 it was decided that bodies should be moved to another area. However, not all of them were removed and buildings were constructed over them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Carthage, Missouri to investigate the Burlingame & Chaffee Opera House. The building has multiple floors and has had various uses over the decades, starting in 1878 when the second floor was an Opera House, the lower level, a hardware store and the basement a mortuary. In the early 1900's the building was sold to Charles E. Turner who owned a carriage and harness company.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Joplin, Missouri to investigate the Holly Hill Estate. The property is comprised of two houses with very different histories. The first house is called Willow Vista, which was built in 1916 and was a private club with ties to the mob. Over the years it was also believed to have been a speakeasy and a brothel. In 1958, a doctor named Donald Patterson bought the Willa Vista and made it into a family home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stay close to home as they investigate two neighboring buildings: Stadium Theatre and Stadium Building in Woonsocket, Rhode Island. Original owner, Arthur Darman constructed the building and the theatre in 1926. His vision for the theatre was to bring live entertainment to those who couldn't afford to travel to New York. The adjacent building was a community hub, which featured doctors' offices, law firms, dentists, and insurance agencies.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lawrenceburg, Kentucky to investigate The Wild Turkey Distillery. Guest investigator, Kristen Luman, as well as two familiar faces, Dustin and KJ join the team. The descendent of the founding family, Olivia Ripy, calls the team in to investigate. Her family started making whiskey as far back as 1869 and in 1935, her grandparents went into business as the Ripy Brothers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hyde Park, New York to investigate the Culinary Institute of America. Built in the early 1900's the building was originally a seminary for young men looking to become Jesuit priests. It was shut down in 1969 due to diminishing enrollment. The Culinary Institute took over the building two years later.
programme.sub-title: Too Many Apparaitions in the Kitchen

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home on this investigation as they travel to Newport, Rhode Island to investigate Fort Adams, the largest coastal fortress ever constructed on US soil. This is the second fort built on the site. The original structure was built in 1799 and stood through 1812. The fort was rebuilt from 1824-1857 and could hold 468 cannons, where as the first could only hold 20. Many deaths were reported but had nothing to do with battle but rather, murder, suicide, and illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Bennington, Vermont to investigate Southern Vermont College. Edward Everett was a wealthy man who built his mansion on these grounds between 1911-1914. He was married twice and had 5 children. When he died in 1929 his estimated worth was between $40-$50 million. The legend that students have passed down through the years is that Edward's first wife, Amy, committed suicide, and didn't die of poor health, which was reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the Conrad-Caldwell Castle, the masterpiece built by well-known architect, Arthur Loomis. The house took 3 years to complete and was the symbol of success for the original owner, Theophilus Conrad and his wife, who started out as poor immigrants before working their way up to being wealthy industrialists. The couple lived in this home for ten years, before Mr. Conrad died of a heart attack on the basement stairs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Lenox, Massachusetts to investigate The Mount, a location they first visited in 2008. Built in 1902, the Mount was designed and built for Pulitzer Prize winning author, Edith Wharton and her husband, Teddy. When their marriage started to fall apart in 1911, the couple moved out and eventually divorced. This renowned property is where Edith wrote many of her best sellers, and had famous friends visit, including Henry James.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Boston, Massachusetts to investigate the USS Constitution, the oldest commissioned warship still afloat in the world and one that also never lost a battle. She was built in 1794 and decommissioned in 1855, then placed in permanent commission in 1940. Today she holds a crew of 60, but at a peak time, during the War of 1812, she had 450-500 people aboard: including 60 marines, 350-400 sailors, and 50 officers/ship boys.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to North Adams, Massachusetts to investigate Houghton Mansion. It was built in 1897 for North Adams' first Mayor, A.C Houghton. Constructed on the foundation of a previous home, The Houghton Mansion was used for the family and fundraisers. The hauntings are said to have begun in 1914 after a tragic car accident took the lives of A.C Houghton and his daughter. His chauffer was driving and was so overcome with guilt that he took his own life the next day. A week later Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Glen Spey, New York to investigate Burn Brae Mansion, which was formerly the summer home of Margaret and Charles Elkin. It was constructed in the early 1900's by Margaret, who was one of seven MacKenzie siblings to build a grand estate in Glen Spey with the money given to her by her father. Several of Charles and Margaret's children passed away young, and their coachman, William attempted suicide on the property, and later died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out by two clients to investigate the Midwest Railway Preservation Society in Cleveland, Ohio. Built in 1907, this rail yard had over 400 people working there 24/7. Some of the jobs were very dangerous with a number of injuries and deaths taking place over the years, with the brakeman being one of the most dangerous. Sometimes people fell off the tops of the trains and died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the season premiere of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cleveland, Ohio to investigate Grays Armory. It was built in 1893 to house the men's only Grays militia force, a force that was to protect the city of Cleveland from any unrest, as there was no National Guard at that point in time. The gray color was chosen to honor the New York grey's for being victorious during the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Detroit, Michigan to investigate The Whitney. Originally built in 1890 by lumber baron David Whitney, it was used as a private residence for him and his second wife, Sarah, along with his four children. At the time the house was built he was the wealthiest man in Detroit, and spared no expense in his home, including adding the first personal use elevator, and $400,000 worth of furnishings from two trips to Europe. Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Toledo, Ohio to investigate the Toledo Yacht Club. Susan Hurst has called the guys in to investigate the club, which first opened in 1865. A fire destroyed it in 1906 and it was rebuilt in 1908. It became well known during the prohibition era, as bootleggers used the docks to smuggle Canadian booze across Lake Erie.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Rose secretly begins seeing Leo, unaware of his history with Stevie. Meanwhile, Riley, Alex, Jodi and Kate take cattle along the stock route overnight.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After Rose and Stevie enthusiastically prepare dinner for Rose's "mystery man," the girls are horrified when they see whom the date turns out to be. Meanwhile, Kate wants to apply for the Young Farmer of the Year award but is crushed when she learns that Jodi has entered as well since Kate has never beaten Jodi at anything.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi has introduced Boer goats onto Drovers and wants to associate them with Gungellan Fresh. Phil Rakich is instantly opposed to the idea and bad mouths the animals, which causes tension with Riley.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Alex returns from the city with Fiona, Stevie fears he's changed his mind about leaving his wife. Meanwhile, Jodi and Patrick fight over who knows Kate the best.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: During a storm, Jodi wakes from a nightmare about fleeing from the hitman with Rob. Stevie wakes alone and full of remorse, while Alex wakes up in his ute, heartbroken after seeing Stevie with another man.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie is trying to deal with the fact that Alex may never be hers. She brings home a very young guy for the night, a move which ultimately endangers the land of Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi comforts Rob and they are brought closer together when he reveals a secret.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After the crop-dusting incident, Drovers has lost its contracts for organic produce and the women struggle to keep the bank from taking over. Trying to help, Stevie ends up gambling away Drover money.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi is stunned when Tess offers her half her share of Drovers Run. Tess feels that Jodi should have equity in the family heritage, as well as sharing their current debt. Leo, the pilot who dumped pesticide on Drovers Run, returns and tries to make Harry lift the black ban placed on him.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Kate falls and when Dave gives her a cursory examination, he notices a small sunspot on her back. After numerous attempts to convince her to see a doctor, Dave abducts Kate and drives her to the Gungellan GP.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick returns home to Drovers Run but is troubled by shadowy flashbacks of Argentina and his mugging. Meanwhile, Kate secretly goes to see a cancer specialist in the city, but Jodi figures out that something is going on and follows her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick is anxious to start up the cattle breeding program he never had the chance to realise in Argentina. Tess and Stevie move Phoenix to a safer paddock, but another visit from the Brumbies leads to the discovery that she is already pregnant, no doubt to the brumby stallion.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi risks her own life in an attempt to save Rob from the hitman that is hunting him, and with her courage, common sense and bushcraft, they survive the daylight risk. Meanwhile, Dave's brother Patrick returns with a truckload of "liberated" goats.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Patrick is blinded in a farming accident, he must rely on Kate for help. Stevie and Fiona take on a dodgy horse dealer, gaining a new-found respect for each other. Meanwhile, Meg and Terry adopt a new dream together.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Regan returns to Drovers Run, she reveals a tragic secret. Though Tess has left, Jodi, Kate, and Stevie allow her to stay. Meanwhile, Fiona learns she is infertile but hides this information from Alex.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Harry's stud ram is stolen, the Drovers Run women unmask an unlikely sheep rustler. Stevie ends up as Alex's backup best man in case Nick is not back from Argentina in time for the wedding.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi is driving back to Drovers Run when her phone rings. For a split second, she takes her eyes off the road and collides with a ute that Harry was driving. Meanwhile, the Japanese trade delegation visits to make an export deal with 'Gungellan Fresh'.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: As he prepares for his father's funeral, Alex becomes obsessed with finding out why Harry had secreted away so many things. Stevie struggles to tell Alex that she argued with Harry on the day he died, and fears that it might have prompted the heart attack that killed him.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Kevin returns unexpectedly and Jodi tells him the news about her real father. He isn't too surprised, though, and Jodi is later devastated to find he was just trying to access her inheritance money.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The day before the big wedding has arrived and Stevie makes a shocking discovery that Fiona has been lying to Alex about being pregnant. Meanwhile, Kate decides to try on Fiona's dress and manages to stain it.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After a group of brumbies are found shot dead, the girls of Drovers Run suspect a handsome stranger named Riley. Meanwhile, Sandra moves back into Killarney in hopes of carrying out Harry's legacy while Alex is absent

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie and Riley have gone into partnership to train the brumbies they saved from the national park, but they clash over techniques when they must have a horse ready for sale in one day. Meanwhile, Sandra and Fiona realise they're at a stalemate when they both secure damaging information about the other.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Regan's horse-riding lessons have paid off. She is feeling confident in her ability and excited by the prospect of riding with the Drovers Cross Country team. After a mistake, Regan discovers that Drovers Run lost a contract to Sandra because she caused a paratyphoid outbreak in some cattle.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When evidence begins to mount against Stevie, Kate starts to believe that she could be the cause of Harry Ryan's death and must decide if she should go to the police with her suspicions. Meanwhile, Riley learns a local trainer abuses his horses and plans to do something about it.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Kate, who went to the police with her suspicions about Stevie's involvement in Harry's death, struggles to deal with the consequences of her actions. Alex returns from Argentina to find much has changed since he left, and he's got a lot to handle straight away.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are determined to discover who killed Harry Ryan. When Leo returns to the district and locks horns with Stevie, she becomes convinced that he is the killer. Meanwhile, Alex discovers that Fiona has lied about her pregnancy.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Taking a short cut along the stock route, Moira is horrified when her petrol tanker has a dangerous fuel spill on Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi and Kate struggle to make a decision about the future of the ranch given the possibility that Stevie may go to jail.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Steve is busy trying to tie up loose ends before her trial begins, and Fiona joins the CFS in an attempt to show Alex how she can integrate herself into the town. When Alex and Riley are away from Killarney, doors all over the property are left open.

programme.desc: When a solicitor falls from a roof to his death, Barnaby and Scott investigate whether it was suicide or murder. Fearful of becoming a murder suspect, Tommy hatches a plan with pal Noel (Darren Healy) to dispose of the body. But his perfect plan unravels when police dogs track down two corpses in the same place: Jean's, and that of a prominent politician's wife.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Brodetto is a savory, soup fish preparation that can be found up and down the coast of Italy. Lidia makes her Brodetto with onion, scallion, clams and mussels and lots of parsley and pepperoncino. Lidia's Walnut Cake is delicate and nutty with just enough espresso to make it truly Italian.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their vegetables, and so does Lidia! This episode will feature three healthy and delicious Italian vegetable dishes including: Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon & Mushrooms; Leek and Prosciutto Grain; and Butternut Squash Soup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love to celebrate life, family and friends. Lidia teaches you how to keep your guests feeling happy with a few of her favorite party tricks. The menu includes Spicy Stuffed Clams with cheesy breadcrumbs, Italian Deviled Eggs made with salsa verde and Meatless Meatballs with Cheese and Quinoa, an addictive bite-size snack. For a little extra run, she'll also show you some of her favorite fruity spritzers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Meatballs are an all-time favorite, and Lidia creates some new versions to add to your meatball repertoire and make those parties memorable. On the menu today, she shares: Lamb Meatballs with Lemon Sauce; Leftover Meatball Panini, Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce, a crispy fried monkfish meatball made in a tomato sauce that includes raisins and pine nuts.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Shaved artichoke, spinach and mortadella salad; mussels, sausage and potatoes in white wine.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Northern Italy has some of the most stunning mountains and scenery on the Italian peninsula. In this episode, Lidia explores some of the classic culinary traditions of this area including a hearty Minestrone soup that she freshens up with pesto. In addition, she makes a delicious Stuffed Cabbage with her grandson, Lorenzo. Desserts are quick and easy and include delicious Italian "gelato."

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter minestrone; roasted squash and carrot salad with chickpeas and almonds.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The 1980s brought a lot of Northern Italian cuisine to New York City. This made Lidia feel at home, as a lot of the flavors central to her childhood were now with her in America. Today's recipes include a Pasta Primavera "New School," which her kids always loved growing up, and the classic Raspberry and Walnut Cookies, a beloved Italian American staple.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dishes using ricotta, including bruschetta, crespelle manicotti and chocolate chip ricotta cookies.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summertime is dinner party season, and Lidia loves to serve family style meals. Today, she'll create a summer menu fit for any celebration. The menu includes grilled skewers of Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini and Tomato Salsa, steamed summery Green Beans with Mint Pesto and Berry Tiramisu - Lidia's summer berry twist one of the most famous Italian desserts!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasting enhances the flavor of any kind of meat and Lidia often makes a roast for family meals. Today's menu includes a Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon and Mushrooms; an easy and elegant Roasted Pork Loin with Cabbage and Dried Cherry Sauce; and Roasted Pear, Blueberry and Grape Compote for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich and six special guests at her holiday table: Christopher Walken, Rita Moreno, Ann Curry, Padma Lakshmi, Marcus Samuelsson, and Carlo Ponti, Jr. Hear the personal stories of each individual's journey to and in America, set against a backdrop in which they share a delicious meal that represents the diverse flavors that are part of celebrating the yuletide in New York.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Home for the Holidays

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love entertaining and celebrating life with family, friends, and food. Today, Lidia shares recipes that fit any kind of party. She starts with Stewed Savory Peppers, a delicious antipasto, especially when served with lots of grilled or toasted bread. Next, she makes Pear Bellini, a fruity and bubbly cocktail guests can sip on while enjoying antipasti; and who doesn't love fried balls of rice? Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. For dessert, summer is still the theme with Peach Granita, although the granita technique can be be made with all kinds seasonal fruits.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia talks about pasta in her family, it's never "basta!" Today, she creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a Linguine with Swisschard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta. She then makes a simple dish of Farfalle with Swordfish, prepared with tomatoes, fresh herbs and capers. And finally, there is nothing better than Lidia's Spaghetti and Meatballs!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Although Italians are not known for a brunch tradition, many of their recipes work beautifully for it. Today's brunch recipes include: Polenta with Honey & Berries; Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta; Rice Balls Stuffed with Sausage Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a dish that is perfect for family and holiday gatherings. Packed with flavor, this crispy oven baked chicken is bursting with lemon goodness. As a side, she makes a Celery Gratin and a Belgian Walnut Salad.

programme.title: Eating In With Lidia
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shares the stories behind the great pantry-inspired recipes that her family has been eating for years--in both good times and challenging ones.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh herbs are simply a must in Lidia's kitchen and today she makes three dishes that highlight herbs AND spices. She begins the menu with Pickled Carrots: a quick pickle of tiny carrots packed with the flavors of parsley, garlic and mint; Braised Beef in Guazzetto: rich, braised beef filled with enticing aromas and Skillet Cauliflower with Lemon and Mint: cauliflower florettes showered with lemon juice and a sprinkle of fresh mint.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite desserts-one spoon dessert, one seasonal fruit based dessert and of course a baked sweet to warm up the kitchen. Her Limoncello Tiramisu is a sweet pick-me-up made with delicious limoncello zabaglione. Fruit is a natural as an Italian sweet to end a meal, and she loves to simply serve Grilled Fruit to magnify their natural sweetness. A favorite Italian cookie is the Chocolate Anise Biscotti, made with a shot of espresso.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The beautiful Adriatic Sea was a big part of Lidia's childhood, as she loved to play on the rocky beach and savor the bounty of the local waters. She prepares Linguine with Clams and Broccoli, a twist on the classic linguine con vongole. She then shows three authentically southern Italian styles of topping a piece of crusty bread for her Bruschetta Three Ways- using Mackerel and Burrata, Anchovy and Butter, as well as Broccolini di Rape and Burrata.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and with over 460 varieties made in Italy, it leads to many mouth-watering cheesy recipes. In this episode, Lidia shares her Cheese Baked in a Crust: gorgonzola wrapped with puff pastry and baked as crispy cheesy bites; Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad: a flavorful and fresh mix of celery, artichoke and mortadella; and finally Meatloaf Ricotta: a family favorite meatloaf dish packed with three different cheeses.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares recipes that are quick to whip up and ideal for days when you don't have much time to cook. She starts off by making Green Beans with Mint Pesto, a fresh alternative to the well-known green beans with butter. For a sweet treat, Lidia makes Chunky Cherry Bread Pudding, one of her favorite ways to recycle day-old bread. Next on the menu is Maremma-Style Steak, an impressive steak that anyone can make at home.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: From jumping the broom to tying the knot, wedding celebrations in America are as diverse as the nation itself, and Lidia cordially invites viewers to be her "plus one" on this cross-country matrimonial odyssey.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Weddings: Something Borrowed, Something New

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia makes pizza the centerpiece for your next party. With a variety of toppings, a salad and dessert, you are ready to go. ON the menu is a classic Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons; individual Pizzette with toppings like onion and cheese; chicken and mushroom; pear and gorgonzola and tomato & pecorino. While you have the dough, why not try a Dessert Pizza, topped with jams, Nutella, chocolate and fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pork guazzetto with beans; matalotta-style mixed fish stew.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The key to a delicious meal is coaxing a lot of flavor from an ingredient, whether it is meat or vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares two ragu recipes: Lamb and Pepper Ragu: and a Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu: a heart, flavorful medley of chestnuts and mushrooms that make for a satisfying vegetarian ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A cheese plate with plum mostarda and gnocco fritto; a platter of cheese with seasonal fruits and plum mostarda; fluffy fried bread served with prosciutto cotto; sausage and apples; risotto with orange juice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: "Alla Parmigiana" is a technique applied in many southern Italian dishes that is all about layering simple bold flavors.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried foods are not eaten often in Italy, but Lidia shares some recipes no one can resist. She makes Crispy Shrimp, a huge hit in her house that is sure to become a favorite in yours too; Crispy Baked Tomatoes, plum tomatoes topped with bread crumbs and baked in the oven until crispy; and finally, Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savoy Cabbage, an ideal main course for a hungry crowd.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are some restaurant favorites that can be cooked at home in this episode! Lidia prepares delicious Butternut Squash Gnocchi and a Pan Seared Halibut with Balsamic Reduction. Delizioso!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple in Lidia's kitchen and she loves planning dinner parties based on seafood. Today's menu includes Swordfish Skewers with a Sweet and Sour Sauce, made with balsamic vinegar and bay leaves; and Stuffed Calamari with bread crumbs, hard-boiled eggs, grated cheese, white wine, and parsley.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the Soup and Sandwhich concept shortly after she arrived in America. And soups are one of her favorite creations to make. In this episode, she prepares a velvety Spinach and ChickpeaSoup; an Italian style Baked Toast Sandwhich and to finish, she enjoys some oatmeal crepes with her grandson Ethan.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Salting your food is an important step in any kitchen, and the type of salt used can make a huge difference in your meal. Today's menu includes: Salted Cod Fritters: Crispy chunky cod fritters made for the perfect salty snack; Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce: an iconic Italian pasta dish with penne rigate in a creamy pink vodka sauce; Beef Chuck and Beer; a rick and flavorful braise that will beckon everyone to the table.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasted chicken with pomegranate and a chocolate ricotta cheesecake; baked beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sweet and sour is a classic combination of flavors that can be found in almost every cuisine around the world, and in Italy it's called agrodolce and produces delicious, balanced dishes of savory and sweet.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The city of Trieste always filled Lidia with excitement, even though she had to flee there to avoid the communist regime in her hometown of Pula. She and her family stayed with her Zia Nina, whose influence on Lidia's cooking is still seen in her recipes today. Recipes include Mussels Triestina, Orange & Raspberry Spritz, and a Coffee Panna Cotta made with a light, sweetened cream.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia as she shares holiday traditions with four families across America. From New York to San Antonio and San Francisco, celebrate Christmas, Passover, and Chinese New Year with Mo Rocca, Stanley Tucci, Ruth Reichl, and more!
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday Tables & Traditions

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When hosting an Italian-style cocktail party, all you need is some drinks, a nice selection of appetizers, and you're set! Back in the kitchen, Lidia creates a menu for the perfect cocktail party. She makes Mussels with Zucchini Salsa Verde, a small appetizer guests can slurp down while sipping on a cocktail. She then makes Bloody Mary, a classic cocktail everyone loves. Corn and apricots work wonderfully together, and Lidia ends with making Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta primavera "new school" with creamy pesto loaded with fresh vegetables; penne with vodka sauce; cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves cooking for her family and today, she shares some of her favorite recipes to make for her grandkids, including a refreshing and kid-friendly Cherry Almond Spritzer; a simple dessert of Grilled Fruit, which brings out the fruit's natural sweetness; and Pasta Salad with Green Beans, Tomatoes and Mozzarella, a great dish for buffets, picnics, and large family gatherings.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Halibut with saffron fregola; tuna and chickpea salad; shrimp alla Buonavia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Comfort food is loved in America, and today, Lidia shares comfort foods Italians love to make. Beef and Potato Goulash, made with sweet Hungarian paprika, is a great recipe for family gatherings. Salads are a favorite of Lidia's, and Country Salad is a welcomed addition to any buffet table. She ends on a sweet note with a luscious Hazelnut Parfait.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Family favorites are the topic in this episode. Lidia starts with a Penne "Al Brucio" made with a spicy tomato sauce, rosemary and a dollup of fresh ricotta. She also shares her famous chicken cacciatore recipe and talks about the best way to make garlic bread. For those looking for a refreshing drink, Lidia shares a delicious and fresh prosecco punch.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sausages with fennel and green olives; seared lamb chops with mint salsa and roasted potato wedges; fragoncello.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are so many varieties of cheese in Italy, and today's recipes feature some delicious ones. Lidia will make a Crostata with Mushrooms and Onion; A quick Salad and Chicken "Involtini" with Kale Pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dandelion and chickpea salad; one-pan chicken and aubergine Parmigiana.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta is a staple in any Italian home and today, Lidia prepares three pasta recipes that will become staples in your kitchen. The first dish on the menu is a quick Ziti with Kale Pesto and Crispy Bacon, a delicious way to recycle any kale pesto leftovers in the fridge. She then makes a delicious summertime pasta made with plum tomatoes, Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto, and finally Campanelle with Shrimp and Fennel, made with "little bells" that carry the chunky sauce so well.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Building the ultimate Italian cheeseboard; skilled sausage and peppers; St. Joseph's zeppole, fried dough filled with vanilla cream topped with Amarena cherries.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Striped bass with broccolini; roasted pepper and olive salad; tomato tart with pecorino Romano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up along the Adriatic sea so picnics at the beach were a common occurrence. Recipes in this episode include some seafood classics from the southern part of Italy including Orecchiette with Peas and Asparagus; Mussels with Farro, Cannellini and Chickpeas and a quick and delicious Chocolate Fig dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday for Heroes Season 1
programme.desc: In this moving special, acclaimed chef and food ambassador Lidia Bastianich pays homage to the men and women of our military and the truly life-saving sacrifices they make daily for our freedom. Lidia meets seven veterans, who share their incredibly inspiring stories.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday for Heroes

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and cauliflower; crespelle with wild cherries, chocolate, and whipped cream; lemon ice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Mushroom ragu; Moka coffee; Kaiserschmarrn, a light and fluffy eggy pancake topped with jam.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter panzanella; a mix of warm roasted vegetables tossed with bread and kale; crespelle bar; farina gnocchi.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rome is one of Lidia's favorite cities, and today's episode features some Roman classic techniques. Recipes include Scallops Saltimbocca and Seared Lamb Chops with Mint Salsa Verde and Roasted Potato Wedges.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia cooks up two Italian American favorites today in her kitchen- Lasagna with Ricotta and Fresh Mozzarella, baked to golden perfectionand Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks, pan fried and made with fresh tomato sauce and mozzarella. To round out the menu, she'll share a Perfect Simple Salad, traditionally eaten at the end of the meal in her Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: At the base of Italian cuisine are essential Italian ingredients and vinegar is one of them. Lidia masters the art of cooking with vinegar in this episode. She prepares a Red Cabbage and Bacon Salad in a warm bacon and balsamic vinegar dressing; Chicken in Vinegar Sauce; and a tangy garlic Savoy Cabbage and Potatoes dish.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia attended school near the beautiful city of Trieste before coming to America and picked up many essential skills from the nuns who ran it. Inspired by the soups she had for school lunches, she prepares a Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup, as well as a one pot meal of Sausages and Apples that can feed a hungry family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Every cook dreams of a perfectly roasted chicken, and today Lidia shows the viewer how to do just that. She starts with an American favorite - a crunchy, cheese Caesar Salad. Her Lemon Roasted Chicken goes beyond comfort food with onions, rosemary and lots of lemons. Finally she prepares a free form Crostata with Juicy Plums.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Striped bass with broccolini; roasted pepper and olive salad; tomato tart with pecorino Romano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grandma Erminia's favorites grace today's menu and include a Rice & Pea Soup; a simple Prosciutto Cotto sandwich and a dish that the family finds on many Sunday menus: Baked Stuffed Shells.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Mussel bruschetta; a tasting of olive oil; spaghetti in lemon cream sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: On today's menu, Lidia serves Chicken and Sausage Bites with Apple Cider Vinegar Sauce, made with rosemary, vinegar, and honey. Fried food always hits the spot and next on the menu is Fried Onion Rings, made Italian-style with Grana Padano cheese added to the batter for flavor and crunch; and finally, Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms is a rich dish that is perfect for colder months.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Eggs were always a favorite at Lidia's home as a kid and they still are. In this episode, she'll prepare Savory Egg Battered Zucchini Roll Ups; a refreshing and simple Fennel, Red Onion and Celery Salad topped with Italian Salami and a luscious Frittata Filled with Ricotta, Tomatoes, Onion and Basil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves entertaining and today, she shares recipes that are fit for any Italian dinner party. Bruschetta is a great party appetizer, and Lidia shares one of her favorite toppings: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta. Next on the menu is Beef and Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine, a hearty-one pol meal your guests will love.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia remembers some of her fondest childhood recipes that were made by her Grandmother Rosa in Italy. Recipes include Mussels Triestina and Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto. A fun and fruity Fruit Smash Soda is shared with her mother, Erminia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Panzanella with fennel and shrimp; orange and tropea onion salad; green salad with apples and provolone; cabbage salad with speck.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A Belgian and endive salad that features a rich egg yolk vinaigrette; naked ricotta dumplings with a sage-butter sauce; stuffed tomatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Braising is a preferred technique in Lidia's kitchen and today she prepares one rich braised meat dish, along with two braised vegetable choices for the home cook. Recipes include: Beef Braised in Barolo; a Braised Kale with Bacon; and finally Braised Cauliflower.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The arrival of Italians into America demanded the need for Italian products as well. This resulted in more creativity and flavor in the kitchen, as Italians began to grow their produce in America. Lidia makes a Belgian & Red Endive Salad as well as a sweet Cherry Jam Tart wrapped up in an almond crust.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The tomato Is not native to Italy, but it made a big impact on Italian cuisine when it arrived centuries ago. From canned to vine ripened, Lidia shares with you several of her favorite tomato dishes including: Stuffed Tomatoes: stuffed with rice, mozzarella and basil; Braised Pork Ribs with Rigatoni: Tender to the bone pork ribs and braising sauce with rigatoni; and Green Beans in Chunky Tomato Sauce: a perfect side of fresh green beans smothered in a fresh chunky tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Focaccia di recco; a quick salad matching salty pecorino Romano cheese with sweet pears and peppery arugula; rigatoni with sausage and cabbage.

programme.desc: Chema les ofrece refugio al Turco y la familia de Aurelio en una de sus casas de Los Ángeles para tenderles una trampa. Mónica tiene que matar al cocinero para poder escapar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio invita al Cabo a San Luis Potosí para eliminar a Colmenares, pero la relación es muy tensa entre ellos. Heriberto negocia con los secuestradores, y Matilde admira su valentía.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco llega a tiempo para salvar al Cabo de la ira de los Casillas, y les entrega los resultados de ADN de Tijeras como prueba de fidelidad. Chacorta sorprende a Matilde en Colombia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio llega al hotel para evitar que Ximena escape, donde se enfrenta al Turco por su engaño. Mejía le pide a Benítez que no le diga al presidente sobre sus sospechas del asesinato de Colmenares.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El presidente Benítez le dice a Marco Mejía que lo respalda y que jamás negociará con criminales. Aurelio espera una respuesta. Chacorta lleva a Matilde al hospital, y Heriberto se pone muy mal.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio invita a comer a Ximena, pero el Cabo y sus hombres llegan hasta el restaurante donde él está y se presenta una balacera. Chacorta se venga de Heriberto al saber de su relación con Matilde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta llevarse a Ximena al extranjero, pero ella logra desarmar a uno de los hombres de Aurelio y lo amenaza. Doña Alba no acepta irse con él, y le canta las verdades en su cara.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio regresa a México y se lleva una sorpresa cuando llega a la bodega, por lo que decide cambiarse el rostro. El Cabo le dice al Chema que él se encarga de encontrar a Casillas con ayuda de Irina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas se somete a cirugía estética, pero el procedimiento se complica y Heriberto pierde el control. Rutila le miente a Ximena por temor al Turco: le dice que extraña a su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Todos creen que Aurelio Casillas ha muerto en una sala de operaciones. Sin embargo, la muerte que tanto impactó al mundo del narco mexicano es, en realidad, una mentira de quien busca venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio captura al Turco y lo tortura para descubrir dónde está el dinero que le robó. Mientras, el Chema Venegas, desconfiando de los Casillas, ordena a Tijeras secuestrar a doña Alba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de un tiroteo, Chacorta y sus hombres rescatan a doña Alba. El Chema se obsesiona con conocer la verdad sobre la muerte de Aurelio, y pide la lista de doctores que lo operaron.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chema les ofrece refugio al Turco y la familia de Aurelio en una de sus casas de Los Ángeles para tenderles una trampa. Mónica tiene que matar al cocinero para poder escapar.

programme.desc: Ximena confiesa que no ama al Turco, que solo sintió agradecimiento por él. Después de matar a Ronnie, Aurelio encuentra a su exesposa, quien le dice que nunca volverá con él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de separarse tras el tiroteo, Aurelio y Ximena se reúnen con sus hijos. El Turco usa a Irina para averiguar el paradero de Casillas, y así poder negociar con él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde quiere aliarse con Chema para hacer un negocio a espaldas de Chacorta. Lay se mete a la tina con Aurelio y, luego de algunas confesiones, pasan una noche de pasión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio visita a Mónica para amenazarla, pero ella recuerda el daño que él le hizo y se defiende. Más tarde, los hombres de Leonor se enfrentan a Chacorta y a Heriberto en una emboscada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Mónica que fingió su muerte para cobrar venganza de sus enemigos. Ximena se reencuentra con su hijo Heriberto, quien necesita de su ayuda para salir del mundo del narcotráfico.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le tiende una trampa al Turco y lo amenaza, pero no recibe respuestas sobre el dinero. Después de mucho buscar a Leo, Ignacio Miravalle la encuentra y jura ayudarla a salir de la cárcel.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica sugiere que Aurelio negocie su propia mercancía y la divida con los colombianos. Doña Alba se interpone cuando la idea separa a los hermanos Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se planean dos ataques durante la reunión entre el presidente mexicano y el director de la DEA de EE. UU. Luego de una injusta pelea, acusan a Leonor de matar a una prisionera.

programme.desc: Mónica descubre que Aurelio viajará con Lay, y en un ataque de celos, amenaza con matarla. El Cabo busca la ayuda de Robles para viajar a Colombia, y le propone trabajar juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto visita a Ignacio y le pide ayuda para salir del país. Mónica le dispara a Irina para evitar que huya de México. Chema quiere obtener ADN de Aurelio para compararlo con el del cadáver.
