The crime resembles a case they solved many years earlier. As the body count rises, they realize they're dealing with a vigilante taking over when the police fail. The similarities between past and present crimes leads the detectives to wonder if they put the wrong man behind bars.

programme.title: Stand Up Guys
programme.desc: After serving 28 years in prison for accidentally killing the son of a crime boss, newly paroled gangster Val (Al Pacino) reunites with his former partners in crime, Doc (Christopher Walken) and Hirsch (Alan Arkin), for a night on the town. As the three men revisit old haunts, reflect on their glory days and try to make up for lost time, one wrestles with a terrible quandary: Doc has orders to kill Val, and time is running out for him to figure out a way out of his dilemma.

programme.title: Killing Them Softly
programme.desc: When rival crook Johnny Amato (Vincent Curatola) hatches a plan to rob a card game run by mob lackey Markie (Ray Liotta), he picks a low-rent thug named Frankie (Scoot McNairy) to do the job. Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. In retaliation, Markie's bosses hire Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), a mob enforcer, to eradicate those responsible.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: When flight attendant Jackie Brown (Pam Grier) is busted smuggling money for her arms dealer boss, Ordell Robbie (Samuel L. Jackson), agent Ray Nicolette (Michael Keaton) and detective Mark Dargus (Michael Bowen) want her help to bring down Robbie. Facing jail time for her silence or death for her cooperation, Brown decides instead to double-cross both parties and make off with the smuggled money. Meanwhile, she enlists the help of bondsman Max Cherry (Robert Forster), a man who loves her.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
programme.desc: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
programme.desc: The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: It is the first year of Germany's occupation of France. Allied officer Lt. He and his men join forces with Bridget von Hammersmark, a German actress and undercover agent, to bring down the leaders of the Third Reich. Their fates converge with theater owner Shosanna Dreyfus, who seeks to avenge the Nazis' execution of her family.

Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. programme.title: Borderlands
programme.desc: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: After returning home to England, aristocrat Robin of Loxley learns that the evil Sheriff of Nottingham has seized his family estate. He soon joins forces with Friar Tuck and Little John -- a fierce Arabian warrior who wants to put an end to the Crusades. Armed with arrows and dubbed Robin Hood, Loxley leads a band of oppressed rebels in a daring plan to rob the Sheriff of his money and take away his power.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Five ordinary teens must become something extraordinary when they learn that their small town of Angel Grove - and the world - is on the verge of being obliterated by an alien threat. Chosen by destiny, our heroes quickly discover they are the only ones who can save the planet. But to do so, they will have to overcome their real-life issues and, before it's too late, band together as the Power Rangers.

programme.title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
programme.desc: Socially awkward Charlie is a wallflower watching from the sidelines, until a pair of charismatic seniors take him under their wing.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: Pilot Brodie Torrance saves passengers from a lightning strike by making a risky landing on a war-torn island -- only to find that surviving the landing was just the beginning. When dangerous rebels take most of the passengers hostage, the only person Torrance can count on for help is Louis Gaspare, an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

programme.title: Silver Linings Playbook
programme.desc: After losing his job and wife, and spending time in a mental institution, Pat Solatano winds up living with his parents. He wants to rebuild his life and reunite with his wife, but his parents would be happy if he just shared their obsession with the Philadelphia Eagles. Things get complicated when Pat meets Tiffany, who offers to help him reconnect with his wife, if he will do something very important for her in exchange.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones.

programme.title: Bangkok Dangerous
programme.desc: Remorseless assassin Joe (Nicolas Cage) is in Thailand to complete a series of contract killings for a crime boss called Surat (Nirattisai Kaljaruek). He hires a street punk named Kong (Shahkrit Yamnam) to run errands for him, all the while planning to kill the youth at the conclusion of his assignment. Instead, Joe becomes Kong's unlikely mentor, and begins a tentative romance with a local shop girl. But as Joe begins to let his guard down, Surat decides it is time to clean house.

programme.title: Bad Moms
programme.desc: Amy (Mila Kunis) has a great husband, overachieving children, beautiful home and successful career. Unfortunately, she's also overworked, exhausted and ready to snap. Fed up, she joins forces with two other stressed-out mothers (Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn) to get away from daily life and conventional responsibilities. As the gals go wild with their newfound freedom, they set themselves up for the ultimate showdown with PTA queen bee Gwendolyn and her clique of seemingly perfect moms.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty
programme.desc: An ordinary woman who struggles with feelings of insecurity and inadequacy on a daily basis wakes from a fall believing she is suddenly the most beautiful and capable woman on the planet. With this newfound confidence, she is empowered to live her life fearlessly and flawlessly, but what will happen when she realizes her appearance never changed?

programme.title: Silver Linings Playbook

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Milagro en el Barrio
programme.desc: Un niño ciego y el hijo de una rica familia se hacen amigos aún en contra de la voluntad de la madre del último.

programme.title: El mexicano
programme.desc: Jacinto, un peleador que vence a todos sus rivales en Estados Unidos, ayuda a su hermano que es atacado por unos irlandeses. El antiguo rival de Jacinto mata a su esposa, por lo que Jacinto busca vengarse.

programme.title: Renuncia por motivos de salud
programme.desc: Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.

programme.title: Secuestro
programme.desc: Urgido de dinero, un publicista (Richard Grieco) se suma a los planes de un secuestrador (Michele Greene).

programme.title: El monasterio de los buitres
programme.desc: Un grupo de monjes experimenta con una vida y puntos de vista liberales.

programme.title: Porros, calles sangrientas
programme.desc: Una banda de delincuentes vende droga en una escuela secundaria y una maestra se atreve a denunciarlos.

programme.title: Hoy He Soñado con Dios
programme.desc: Una mujer tiene tres hijos muy diferentes: una hija fracasada, el otro un boxeador furtivo y su hijo el sacerdote.

programme.title: El fin de un imperio
programme.desc: El teniente del batallón de Rurales, José Antonio Navarrete, es considerado héroe y enemigo de los imperialistas, quienes raptan a su gran amor para atraerlo e imponerle sus condiciones políticas.

programme.title: Reencuentros
programme.desc: Al morir su hermano de leucemia, un niño pobre toma su bicicleta y emprende un viaje a la ciudad en busca de su padre.

programme.title: Bello amanecer
programme.desc: La espectacular belleza de una isleña que despierta entre los pescadores las más ardientes y locas pasiones.

programme.title: Señoritas a Disgusto
programme.desc: Tres mujeres que viven en un pueblo lleno de solteronas alquilan una de sus habitaciones a un apuesto hombre.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: El Llanto de los Pobres
programme.desc: Un joven ilegal es acusado por un robo que no cometió, purga una condena en la cárcel donde sueña con volver a su país.

programme.title: La Dinastía de Drácula
programme.desc: Drácula despierta de su tumba después de dormir por tres siglos y reclama más víctimas para su reino.

programme.title: La trenza
programme.desc: Un pueblo confundido por la religión, persigue a una mujer que robó la trenza de la estatua de la Virgen.

programme.title: Más negro que la noche
programme.desc: Tres hermosas mujeres se trasladan a una vieja casona, heredada por la tía de una de ellas, y presencian cosas extrañas.

programme.title: Para que dure no se apure
programme.desc: Un burócrata decide prestarles el departamento a sus jefes para sus aventuras a cambio de dinero y ascensos. Sin embargo, para ello debe dormir en la calle.

programme.title: Fútbol de alcoba
programme.desc: Un equipo de fútbol femenino se dirige a la capital para competir. Para reforzarlo, el entrenador se viste de mujer.

programme.title: El Dandy y Sus Mujeres
programme.desc: Un hombre finge diferentes profesiones para provocar admiración de sus muchas conquistas y recibir dinero de ellas.

programme.title: Me llaman violencia
programme.desc: Una mujer logra escapar de los asesinos de su padre, mientras huye conoce a un hombre que le ofrece protección.

programme.title: Kapax del Amazonas
programme.desc: Una antropóloga norteamericana viaja en un avión con su esposo, periodista y aviador. Se accidentan y caen en la mitad de la selva, él es devorado por las alimañas mientras Linda es rescatada por un aborigen.

programme.title: Mi nombre es Gatillo
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

programme.title: El cachas de oro
programme.desc: Un conocido juez persigue a unos violadores y asesinos, hijos de Ramsés, y los mete a la cárcel, pero su padre los libera, por lo que el valiente juez se ve obligado a matarlos. Ramsés se vengará del juez matando a su prometida.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Mujer de Cabaret
programme.desc: La hermosa y popular cantante de un club nocturno es condenada injustamente por un asesinato.

programme.title: Los dos hermanos
programme.desc: Un hombre rico y poderoso está casado con una mujer mucho más joven, la cual tiene un amante.

programme.title: Amargo destino
programme.desc: Un hombre es encarcelado por un crimen ocurrido accidentalmente y, al salir libre, la mala suerte lo persigue.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: Wild Wonders Ep.4
programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique \"rock rhyme\" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The Dynasty of Oracle Bones Ep.3
programme.desc: Over 3000 years ago, inscriptions were made into the bones of oxen and the undersides of turtle shells for the purpose of divination. Broken down into six comprehensive episodes, this series will enlighten you on the Shang Dynasty when they first appeared, as well as their role in the formation of Chinese writing.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper

programme.title: Treasures and Masks Ep.1

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: In this episode of Chewed Up, hosts Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon explore the world of peanut butter through a blind taste test of six popular brands, discussing texture, flavor, and baking applications. They identify standout options across smooth, chunky, and nostalgic categories, then demonstrate two versatile peanut butter recipes: a quick Asian-inspired spicy peanut sauce made with soy sauce, sesame oil, rice wine vinegar, and chili crisp served over udon noodles, and an elegant dessert of pitted dates stuffed with peanut butter, drizzled with dark chocolate, and finished with flaked sea salt. Both recipes highlight peanut butter's versatility as a protein-rich ingredient for quick meals, snacks, and desserts.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London dive into the wardrobes of Grease's secondary characters, exploring the film's iconic 1950s-inspired costumes. They discuss Stockard Channing's chic black shirt dress as Rizzo, Frenchie's memorable pink hair sequence, the contrast between good girl Patty Simcox and bad girl Cha Cha DiGregorio, and standout prom looks including velvet green dresses and sequined designs. The hosts also reflect on the film's casting of actors in their 30s as high schoolers and debate the merits of Sandy's transformation into "bad Sandy" by film's end, while appreciating costume designer Albert Wolsky's bold color and pattern choices throughout.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Simply Symons hosts an at-home date night episode featuring grilled whole branzino prepared Greek-style with oregano, lemon, olive oil, and fresh dill. Michael Symon demonstrates grilling techniques using a fish basket, filleting methods, and the benefits of cooking whole fish on the bone for moisture and flavor. Liz Symon creates a grapefruit rose sour cocktail using grapefruit-rose infused vodka, lemon juice, egg white, and Cointreau. The hosts discuss cost-saving benefits of preparing restaurant-quality dishes at home, proper fish selection options, and the simplicity of Mediterranean-inspired cuisine. Guest Liv Annacone participates throughout, while the hosts playfully banter about fish preparation and date night logistics.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly wraps up Home Alone Week with the dish his husband Damon absolutely refuses to eat: a comforting Indian-inspired Tofu Sag Paneer riff that Clinton makes happily for himself when he has the kitchen to himself. The hosts celebrate the week's revelation that the most personal food choices are often the ones that define us most.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: A special compilation episode looking back at the best Chew It or Screw It moments from the past six months, featuring some of the show's most memorable guests playing along as the hosts ask them to weigh in on food, lifestyle, and totally random preferences. Segments include: Danielle Sepsy (the Scone Queen) forced to choose between scones and muffins—predictably choosing scones—plus her takes on stuffing vs. mashed potatoes and canned vs. homemade cranberry sauce; Liz Symon (Michael's wife) on orange wine, foofy cocktails, lazy sundaes, the New York Times Spelling Bee app (Queen Bee 99% of the time), stinky cheese, and the truth about cuddling with Michael; Marysol Castro on Citi Field hot dogs, pineapple on pizza (a hard Bronx no), and celebrity cameos at sporting events (the exception being Bad Bunny); Amanda Freitag and the crew on going out to eat on Valentine's Day (screw it—you get the worst service and cooks who rarely go out); Devyn Simone on cooking for someone on a first date (surprisingly chew it, as long as boundaries are established) and not texting the next day after getting lucky; Esther Choi on breakfast for dinner, ketchup on eggs (a unanimous screw it from the entire panel); Scott Conant on sending food back at a restaurant (screw it—you're an adult, figure it out), family style with strangers (chew it), and splitting the check 12 ways; Damaris Phillips on cornbread with sugar, Miracle Whip with bologna, and the boat-ride romance that made her appreciate Miracle Whip on a sandwich; Maneet Chauhan on spicy desserts, taking the last bite when sharing a dish (chew it if you're single and looking for a partner), and eating off someone else's plate; Mika Leon on the five-second rule, helicopter parenting, staying up 24 hours to cook (chew it—she did 32-plus hours on a cooking competition), and going to the club (hard pass, she's tired); and Chef Jackie Bula on air fryers (screw it—just fry), and reality cooking competitions (screw it—it's less about the food than the show). Audience engagement prompts woven throughout invite viewers to comment on their own chew-it-or-screw-it takes.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Chewed Up Compilation #2: BLOOPERS showcases the funniest and most unexpected moments from season four. Clinton accidentally consumes a THC-infused beverage before reading fan mail, Michael passionately debates whether air fryers are just convection ovens and defends wood cutting boards, and Carla reveals her unconventional Christmas card habits. The episode features heated discussions about bagel varieties, seed oils, Instagram fitness culture, and holiday movie preferences. The climax occurs during a butter cookie demonstration when a frozen egg yolk refuses to incorporate and a pastry bag catastrophically fails on camera, turning an otherwise polished cooking segment into comedic chaos.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: The Chewed Up crew sets up poolside at the W Hotel South Beach for a breezy St. Patrick's Day episode that swaps corned beef for Cuban grilled shrimp. Michael Symon, whose Cleveland neighborhood is deeply Irish, admits he's been celebrating St. Patrick's Day with his best friend Jimmy for decades, and this year Jimmy joins them in Miami. Michael's Grilled Shrimp Mojo is a tribute to the Cuban flavors of Miami: shrimp marinated in lime zest, lime juice, chili flakes, and olive oil, then grilled and finished with a vibrant mojo sauce blended from sour orange, onion, a whole head of garlic, cilantro, parsley, and oregano. The key tip: cook shrimp until they look like commas, not O'sóthe moment they curl completely is the moment they're overdone. Clinton reflects on his seven years living in Miami and the city's culinary depth, from Cuban staples to modern restaurants like Yardbird. Carla raises her fear of sharks; Clinton counters with his inexplicable terror of birds getting caught in his hair. Michael confesses he bought a bathing suit specifically to go to the beach, put it on, saw himself in the mirror, and decided to spend the afternoon in bed instead.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Just in time for National Ravioli Day, acclaimed chef and Chopped judge Scott Conant joins the trio at the W South Beach to make his delicate ricotta gnocchiótechnically gnudióalongside his signature Martone Street jarred tomato sauce. Michael has been close friends with Scott for 15 years, and Clinton admits he was genuinely nervous before meeting the notoriously stern Chopped judge, quickly discovering he's warm and funny in person. Scott explains that Martone Street is named for his grandparents' home in Waterbury, Connecticut, where Sunday dinners taught him that conversation over food is one of life's greatest gifts. The gnocchi dough combines fresh ricotta, basil, breadcrumbs, flour, egg, and Parmesan, shaped into small dumplings and cooked until they float. Scott builds a stabilized butter sauce using pasta water and cornstarch as an emulsifieróa trick that keeps it smooth for hours. Finished with Martone Street sauce and broccoli rabe, the result is stunning in its simplicity. His philosophy runs throughout: spaghetti aglio e olio, done correctly, is one of the most complex and satisfying dishes imaginable. Scott becomes emotional talking about watching his 16-year-old daughter drive for the first time and the joy of steak cook-offs with his girls at home.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: In this Halloween-themed episode, Carla Hall assumes the role of Queen of Halloween and welcomes Clinton Kelly and Michael Symon for a spooky celebration. Guest Jeanette Donnarumma returns to demonstrate crafty crescent roll appetizers including coffin pizza pockets, mummy dogs wrapped in crescent dough, and spider bites. The hosts also create Halloween mocktails like the Purple Potion Punch and HALL-o-Ween Hot Honey Punch. The Crafty Lumberjacks join to showcase easy party crafts including pumpkin photo frames, witch wine bottles, glue gun candelabras, temporary tattoo candles, and pumpkins wrapped in festive tights. Recipes featured include Pumpkin Cheesecake Crescent Moons and various appetizers perfect for Halloween gatherings.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Food Network Star winner and Southern food authority Damaris Phillips brings a taste of Louisville poolside at the W South Beach, demonstrating three Southern tea sandwich classics that are anything but fussy. Carla Hall has been singing Damaris's praises for yearsómutual friend Jackie Guido insisted they were destined to be peas and carrotsóand the episode proves her right, the two radiating warmth and joy throughout. Damaris makes Pimento Cheese; Benedictine, a Louisville specialty of grated cucumber with dill and cream cheese (the key being squeezing out all the cucumber water first); and Ham Salad, essentially chicken salad's porky cousin, versatile as either sweet or savory. Everything is layered on Japanese milk bread or thin white bread, crusts removed, and assembled into dainty finger sandwiches and triple-decker stacks. Michael immediately tries to build an enormous open-face sandwich rather than the delicate bites Damaris intended, sparking a lively debate about proportion and restraint. Carla shares that she recently spent a cozy Super Sunday with Damaris in Louisvilleóa beloved tradition of soups, board games, and community. The episode also features a spirited group effort to talk Damaris out of her plan to get a leopard-print face tattoo, with limited success. The episode ends with genuine laughter, warm hugs, and unanimous agreement: the sandwiches are delicious.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Two-time Tournament of Champions winner and Chopped veteran Maneet Chauhan arrives at the W South Beach as a true Queen of Flavor, demonstrating her Indian Spiced Ceviche, a dish that applies Indian culinary logic to coastal Latin technique. Fresh fish is cured in lime juice in the traditional ceviche manner, then transformed with coconut milk to soften the heat and balance the citrus, and finished with a tarka: the Indian technique of blooming whole spices in searing hot coconut oil and pouring it directly over the dish at the last second. The result is layered, bright, and unexpected. Maneet explains that she grew up in a small town in India and learned to cook by exploring her neighbors' kitchens, each representing a different regional tradition. She recounts a pivotal story from Peru, where she made potato pancakes alongside a local woman without sharing a single word of common languageóconnected entirely through food and gesture. That philosophy runs through her Nashville restaurant, which introduces diners to bold Indian flavors through fusion dishes like hot chicken korma and chicken tikka salad poutine. She draws a parallel between the tarka and the French beurre blancóboth finishing techniques that transform a dish in the final seconds of cooking. Michael, Clinton, and Carla taste the ceviche with genuine surprise and awe.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: As the Chewed Up crew wraps up their week at the W South Beach, Miami-born chef Mika Leon brings the most authentically local dish of the entire trip: Pan Con Lechon, the slow-roasted Cuban pork sandwich that anchors Noche Buena, Cuban Christmas Eve. Mika woke up at 4 AM to start the pork shoulderómarinated overnight in a mojo sauce built on sour orange juice, lime juice, orange juice, and 50 cloves of garlic from her grandfather's recipe. After six hours at 350 degrees, the pork is shredded and crisped with additional mojo in a hot pan, then piled high on a special Cuban rollósweeter and fattier than regular bread, made with lard throughout. Mika shares her journey from dabbling in TV production (she quit after a week) to opening a food truck selling $5 Pan Con Lechons at 3 AM to Miami club-goers, which grew into a full restaurant and now a cookbook. Carla notes that the best cooks often learn from family before any formal training, and this dish proves it. The group discusses Miami's cultural identityómore its own country than a Florida cityódefined by Spanglish, its own traffic logic, and immigrant food traditions passed down for generations. Clinton finally admits that despite a full week at the W, none of them ever made it into the pool.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: The South Beach week closes with a live audience tapingóthe most unhinged episode of the tripóas Michael Symon, Carla Hall, and Clinton Kelly perform in front of a crowd of fans. Michael's voice is noticeably shot from a long week of celebrating, so Clinton and Carla carry extra energy while he freestyle hosts from notes he promptly loses within 30 seconds. Carla makes her refreshing Pineapple Lime Agua Fresca: blended fresh pineapple with lime water (lime juice diluted to avoid sharpness), ginger, honey, and wateróa batched mocktail or cocktail mixer that's as beautiful as it is easy. She shares her tip for getting full use of citrus by zesting before juicing. The episode features 'Chew It or Screw It,' a voting game where the audience weighs in on Florida's most adventurous foods: iguana pizza, python sausage, alligator ribs, conch fritters, and fried frog legs. Carla and Clinton report on their spontaneous 7 AM sunrise bike rideótheir first ever togetheróand Clinton jokes about his impossibly pale, non-tanning legs. The trio explores Florida's wildlife peculiarities, from iguanas falling from trees in cold snaps to flying cockroaches given affectionate nicknames. A Chewed Up Challenge heads-up guessing game rounds out the audience interaction with giveaways. Season 3's Miami week ends exactly how it began: loud, funny, and hungry.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime: Niku Udon; Lemongrass-Caramel Chicken; Stir-Fried Angel Hair Pasta - Chris is in the kitchen to take you through three winning recipes from his rotation: A comforting udon noodle dish with thin slices of beef in a smoky, savory, slightly sweet broth; simple braised/stir-fried chicken that is somewhere between Vietnamese clay pot catfish and Taiwanese Three Cup Chicken; and a go-to quick pasta with tofu and veggies stir-fried in a flavor-packed sauce.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Sliders 3-ways, Because Kids Love Small Food: Kids love to eat small foods! It's a fact. Chris Ying shares three different ways he makes miniature burgers for his family, including Dad's Hacky BBQ Pork Char Siu, a ground pork slider and a traditional ground beef slider.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Fluffy, Buttery Biscuits for the Kiddos: Let's be clear: These are not the biscuits that chef Joshua Skenes used to serve at his three-Michelin-star restaurant Saison. Have I had those biscuits? Yes. Have I watched Josh make biscuits? Yes. Do I have his recipe in my phone? Maybe. Do I glance at that recipe whenever I set out to make biscuits for my kids? Well, wouldn't you? Jokes aside, Josh's biscuits are world-class, and are a product of not just the recipe, but his products and experience. I'm never gonna get them exactly right, but the ones I make are inspired by his. They're definitely passable and my kids can take them in whichever direction they like. My daughter likes it savory. My son likes them smothered in jam.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Sunday Gravy All Week: We don't need to tell you that kids like spaghetti and meatballs. Who doesn't? And Sunday gravy—with its chunks of fatty meat and sausage bobbing around in red sauce with the meatballs—is even better. Now, the real prize is what else you can do with that gravy. It's not just for lasagna and eggplant parm. Chris Ying shows you his Sunday Gravy recipe, and then how to take that same punchy, meaty, tomato-based umami sauce and use it to make beefy bean and cheese burritos and ratatouille.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Chris Ying cooks three easy breakfasts that you and (hopefully) your kids will love! The first recipe is for a physics-defying Swedish waffle that only has three ingredients (and are unbelieveably light and crispy). Next Chris makes a sticky rice omelette inspired by Nadine Levy Redzepi that is so simple and delicious. Just little chunks of Thai sticky rice fried crisp, then blanketed in egg. Finally Chris makes a family favorite—pork floss pancakes. These are similar to scallion pancakes and one of the best (and hackiest) paths to to Chinese breakfast pastries.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Stuffed Cabbage (It's Hiding a Giant Meatball!): Sometimes you just need to wrap a delicious meatball in something that makes you feel like you're giving your kids a vegetable. Maybe your kids will reject the cabbage wrapper and leave for you to snack on, or maybe this is the one time that convinces them that cabbage is amazing? Either way, Chris Ying shows you another go-to recipe that is easy and flexible—seasoned meatballs wrapped in cabbage leaves and cooked in a delicious, tomato-y broth.

programme.title: Doolittle's Raiders: A Final Toast
programme.desc: The bottle of 1896 Hennessy Cognac was uncorked in front of hundreds of people. The surviving World War II veterans from one of historys greatest military missions were about to raise their silver goblets one last time ending a decades long tradition. It was time for the veterans to hold this final toast. They could wait no longer. Their numbers had dwindled to just a few. Many of the names of the 80 flyers who took part in the April 18, 1942 raid on Japan may not be familiar to most, but collectively they will always be known in history as the Doolittle Tokyo Raiders. Long ago these American flyers, aboard 16 B-25 bombers, had accomplished a daring mission that changed the morale of an entire nation. The aviators, led by famed commander Lt. Col. James Harold Doolittle, had taken the fight directly to the enemy for the first time in the war and delivered retribution for Japans sneak attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941.

programme.title: War Journal: The Incredible World War II Escape of Major Damon Rocky Gause
programme.desc: The thrilling true story of a nearly impossible escape from prison camp during World War II. In 1942, American airman Rocky Gause escaped a prison camp on the Bataan Peninsula, swam to nearby Corregidor Island, and then sailed with U.S. serviceman William Osborne in a leaky fishing boat 3,200 miles from the Philippines to Australia. Despite facing typhoons, constant threats from Japanese ships, submarines and airplanes, a lack of water and food, and even a visit to the worlds largest leper colony, both men survived to recount their harrowing 52-day ordeal. Filmed in Bataan, Corregidor, and in Manila, the documentary features the journals of Gause and Osborne, archival footage and photos, and interviews with relatives and Army associates. It is narrated by three-time Emmy Award-winning actor Chandler Massey, and actor Kyle Chandler (Argo, Zero Dark Thirty and Carol) provides the voice of Rocky.

programme.title: Higgins Ridge
programme.desc: The incredible story of 20 elite firefighters (smokejumpers) who parachuted into the Idaho wilderness to put out a wildfire burning on a mountain ridge. What looked like a routine fire from the air became a different story on the ground, as wind fueled the blaze into a blowup. The smokejumpers, many in their first season on the job, pivoted from battling the fire to fighting for their lives as the fire surrounded them. Instinctively wanting to run to safety, they remembered the fate of 13 firefighters who unsuccessfully tried to outrun a fire in Montana's Mann Gulch 12 years earlier. With that tragedy in mind, the smokejumpers made the call to shelter in place. Skilled backcountry pilot Rod Snider set out to find them in a helicopter, with treacherous conditions due to the wind, and a lack of visibility due to the smoke. Now in his 90s, Snider revisits the unimaginable saga seared into his memory, revealing a story about bravery and brotherhood.

programme.title: Grandpa's War Story Goes Viral
programme.desc: For Alaskan teenager Henry De Hoop, social media platforms such as Facebook have provided a unique opportunity to share the World War II story of his grandfather, James (Jim) Schmidt, with a global audience. Narrated by Liev Schreiber, GRANDPAS WAR STORY GOES VIRAL shares the remarkable account of Jims World War II service and military career, as well as Henrys efforts to generate interest in his grandfathers war journey and launch a letter-writing campaign on his behalf.Like 16 million others of his generation, Jim responded to the national call to duty following the bombing of Pearl Harbor in 1941. The twist in the story? Jim was only 14 when he enlisted, and the eighth-grade Californian left home without telling his parents. After being wounded in the invasion of Sicily, Jims age was eventually revealed and he was sent home. Not to be deterred, Jim would do stints in both the U.S. Navy and Merchant Marines before finally reaching 18 and officially rejoining the Army. Grandson Henry marveled that Jim joined the war effort at the same age he was when he first shared Jim's story on social media.GRANDPAS WAR JOURNEY GOES VIRAL charts a story of service that began in a movie theater in 1942 where the film Parachute Battalion grabbed a boys attention and ends in the jungles of Vietnam more than two decades later.

programme.title: Broadside
programme.desc: Reduce that people to an entire submission.Charles II. August 28, 1664: The daily business of the Dutch settlement on Manhattan, New Amsterdam, comes to an abrupt halt as four English warships appear in the lower bay. Peter Stuyvesant, the colonys Director General, shores up defenses of the fort while sending a polite welcome to the Commander of the English squadron, Richard Nicolls. Nicolls has been sent by King Charles II to Reduce that people to an entire submission to us and secure that tradewhich the Dutch have wrongfully possessed themselves. He demands Stuyvesant and the town rendered to his majestys obedience, and protection. and has 96 cannons and three companies of troops to affect his orders. Stuyvesant, beset by decades of neglected defenses and the refusal of his own people to fight, surrenders without firing a shot. New Amsterdam becomes New Yorkfor nowas Charles provokes an all out war with the Dutch.

programme.title: Broadside
programme.desc: De Witt Meddles; God punishes London for Holmes Bonfire. Dutch are perhaps overconfident after the 4 Days Battle. But on Saint James Day they have fewer ships than the English (72 vs. 87) and, as usual, less firepower per ship. Moreover, unwisely, De Witt aligns his fleet to minimize the damage to certain flagships, which results in a cannon-duel favoring the English. De Witts meddling causes the Dutch to get much the worst of this battle. Blasting away for days in June and July, neither side can decisively follow up its victory. Tens of thousands killed, the wealth of both nations reduced to flotsam on the North Sea, and unspeakable hardships for each country...for what? Dutch privateers interdict coal bargesit will be very cold in London this winter. And, the Dutch are about to have a visit from Robert Holmes. Holmes gets a tip from a pusillanimous Dutchman about a large merchant fleet near the island of Terschelling. Holmes attacks, destroys one hundred fifty ships, and, to get his troops who are rampantly pillaging back on their ships, burns down Terschelling. Holmes Bonfire is a dangerous escalation of a horrific war. And, when the city of London burns to the ground a month later, many of the Dutch Elect see it as a work of God. Moreover, one Dutchman, Johan De Witt, plans to carry the war to the heart of England.

programme.title: Rick Steves' Europe: A Symphonic Journey
programme.desc: Join Rick Steves and the Cincinnati Pops Orchestra on a spectacular musical journey through Europe in RICK STEVES' EUROPE: A SYMPHONIC JOURNEY. This unique, hour-long special shot by CET Cincinnati blends powerful Romantic-era anthems from composers like Strauss, Grieg, and Verdi with breathtaking visuals and Rick's cultural insights. Experience Europe's history, the passion for freedom, and the spirit of unity across borders. Perfect for lovers of music, history, and travel.

programme.title: Girl Told Can't Be Ballerina
programme.desc: Kaia, a talented dancer from a poor family, dreams of ballet but is held back by her cynical mother. With her ballet coach's support, Kaia secretly trains and auditions, eventually achieving success and buying her mom a house.

programme.title: Girls Compete To Be Prettiest At School
programme.desc: At an elite school, beauty is power. Insecure Moon, a new student, is drawn into the "Shining Star" competition, where ruthless Lucy sabotages rivals. Moon eventually exposes Lucy's deceit, redefining beauty and crowning kindness.

programme.title: Poor Student Hides Being Genius
programme.desc: A scholarship student, Ryan, faces bullying for his poverty and struggles with dyslexia. Secretly tutored by a kind security guard, Ryan excels in math, earns respect, and later uses his success to uplift his family and help his mentor reunite with his estranged son.

programme.title: Girl Won't Show Face In Summer Camp
programme.desc: Callie, jealous of her prettier sister Elise, convinces her to hide behind a mask. When their mom intervenes, Callie realizes her insecurity. The sisters reconcile, and Callie empowers her friend, Peyton, to embrace her unique talents.

programme.title: Opposite Siblings Swap Lives For 72 Hours
programme.desc: Nerd Freddy, overshadowed by his popular brother Tucker, wishes to trade lives. A magical snow globe grants his wish, thrusting Freddy into Tucker's cool life. He thrives, while Tucker struggles. They learn the grass isn't always greener, ultimately embracing their true selves.

programme.title: Kids Build Secret Gaming Room To Hide From Mom
programme.desc: Jay tricks his mom into taking a vacation so he can build a secret gaming room. His plan succeeds until his mom's early return exposes his lies, leading to a hilarious punishment that teaches him a valuable lesson in honesty.

programme.title: Kids Cheat Mrbeast For $1 Million
programme.desc: Dhar Mann challenges fans to meet MrBeast for $1M. Mikey and Jay cheat through the games but get busted, leaving honest Derek to win. The sore losers go out with a bang, ruining the finale by pieing MrBeast and Jay Shetty in front of everyone.

programme.title: Kid Completes 100 Dares In 24 Hours
programme.desc: After accepting a $100 dare, Nathan completes 100 gross and embarrassing challenges set by Colin. When Nathan finishes, Colin admits he never had the money. Bruno, whom Nathan dared to mess with, confronts Colin, who runs off, and Omar buys the Airpods Nathan took as "payback" for the $100.

programme.title: Kid Chooses Cool Guys Over Friends
programme.desc: Middle schooler Jay, hoping to impress his cousin Tiffany, ditches his friends to play basketball with high schoolers who only want him to get close to Tiffany. Jay's friends expose the truth, leading to an epic basketball showdown.

programme.title: A TikTok Prankster Goes Too Far
programme.desc: Frank "the Prankster" records his escalating pranks on classmates for TikTok fame, causing chaos and damage. When his biggest prank targets the principal, he's caught on camera by his victims. This leads to Frank facing consequences, ultimately apologizing, learning that actions have consequences.

programme.title: New Cool Kid Steals Shy Kid's Girl
programme.desc: Middle schooler Kyle's jealousy over new student Archie threatens his chance with crush Candace. Guided by his father Darrel, Kyle faces his insecurities. He apologizes, and both Kyle and his parents reconcile their relationships at the school dance.

programme.title: Student Takes IQ Serum To Impress Girl
programme.desc: Chad, a lazy law student, uses a "genius serum" to ace exams and impress a girl. When the serum's effects fade, he faces academic and financial ruin, forcing him to abandon shortcuts and embrace hard work, ultimately finding true success.

programme.title: Popular Kid Shamed for Hand-Me-Downs
programme.desc: After Pete is shamed for his small hand-me-downs, he turns to shoplifting. He soon learns his parents only sold their car to pay for his brother's secret cancer treatment. Pete repents to honor him.

programme.title: Roommate Sabotages Guys Date
programme.desc: Sam plans an elaborate Valentine's Day for Tyra, but his jealous roommate Chad sabotages everything. Despite the mishaps, Tyra is touched by Sam's thoughtful, homemade gifts, ultimately choosing his genuine affection over Chad's flashy but deceitful gestures.

programme.title: Ladykracher

programme.title: Ladykracher

programme.title: Ladykracher

programme.desc: Als ob der Job im Freizeitpark nicht schon anstrengend genug wäre: ohne das Maskottchen-Kostüm wird es allerdings nicht leichter. Außerdem zeigt Anke, was es bedeutet Opfer des Trickfickers zu werden oder wie Onka eine Yogastunde leitet.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Bonuspunkte an der Kasse kann doch keiner mehr sehen – Koi-Karpfen sind dagegen der letzte Schrei! Das kann man von einer Darmspiegelung nicht gerade sagen, aber der gemeine Arschkriecher muss ja irgendwie wieder raus.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Kinderschminken kann aber auch einfach unheimlich echt wirken – Vorsicht ist angesagt! Sensible Küchengeräte wiederum sollte man nicht mit Horrorfilmen verschrecken. Diese und weitere Weisheiten gibt's bei Ladykracher.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: „Haben Sie mal einen Moment Zeit“? Diese Frage ist meist nur der Anfang vom Ende – erst recht bei Ladykracher! Da kann auch mal ein Badenazi genauer unter die Lupe genommen werden und ein Mann schwanger sein. Verrückt? Ja, das ist Ladykracher!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Egal ob als naive Ulla, magische Mutter oder männerfressende Onka – Anke weiß immer zu überzeugen. In dieser Episode ist sie unter anderem in einer Änderungs-Cafeteria unterwegs oder aber tritt ihrem Chef als Geist gegenüber.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: So manch Hundebesitzer schafft es nicht den Kot seines Hundes zu entsorgen. Anke hat da ihre ganz eigene Methode den Gehweg sauber zu halten. Aber hat sie da vielleicht etwas falsch verstanden?!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Beim Cash Call Gewinnspiel der lokalen Radiosender kann sich selbst die Polizei nicht zurück halten. Deswegen muss die Leitung möglichst schnell wieder frei für den nächsten wichtigen Gewinn-Anruf sein.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: In Zeiten der globalen Erwärmung sollte man sich auch beim Kopieren Gedanken um die Umwelt machen und möglichst wenig Papier verschwenden – Auch wenn es um Kopien der eigenen Geschlechtsteile geht.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Ob "Beziehungen", "Castingbits" oder "Nackt" - bei dem großen Ladykracher-Special gibt es das große A-Z zu Deutschlands beliebtester Sketchcomedy. programme.title: Beautiful People
programme.desc: Eine britische Comedyserie über den dreizehnjährigen Simon Doonan und seiner Familie in Reading. In dieser Folge erfahren wir, wie Simon seine Posh Spice Puppe bekam. Als Simon Doonan dreizehn Jahre alt war, wurde Großbritannien von den Spice Girls regiert. Wenn Simon auf der Schule wegen seiner Vorliebe für die Spice Girls verprügelt wird, entschließt sich Vater Andy, ihm ein wenig Fußball beizubringen. Währenddessen kommt Schwester Ashlene recht erschrocken nach Hause und lernt Tante Hayley einen neuen Mann kennen.

programme.title: De Troon
programme.desc: Guillot war gerade erst Großvater von Wilhelm „Wiwill“ geworden, bevor er die Presse von der Heirat seines Vaters mit einer flämischen römisch-katholischen Admiralstochter erfahren lässt. Kurze Zeit später tritt Wilhelm I. zu Gunsten seines verhassten Sohnes zurück und zieht nach Berlin. 1848 zwingen Thorbeckes liberale Regierung und das Volk Wilhelm II. eine neue Verfassung zu unterschreiben, was dem unfähigen Kronzprinzen Wilhelm „Kleintie“ gar nicht recht ist.

programme.title: The Switch
programme.desc: Endlich ist es soweit, Sü hat ihren Real-Life-Test überstanden: Sie hat ein Jahr lang in ihrem bevorzugten Gender gelebt und gearbeitet und muss sich jetzt nur noch mit einem Arzt treffen, um Genehmigung für ihre Geschlechtsumwandlung zu bekommen. Leider scheint Dr. Zylol für so eine wichtige Position eher ungeeignet. Währenddessen versucht Zoey mit ihrer eigenen Genderidentität klarzukommen, was für Patin Sandra wie immer eine große Herausforderung darstellt.

programme.title: Brave New Girls
programme.desc: Kanadische TV-Serie über die Transfrau Jenna Talackova. Mit ihrer neuen PR-Managerin Vanessa reist Jenna nach New York, um Kontakte zu knüpfen und um weitere Modelerfahrung zu sammeln. Jenna will aber auch die Stadt erkunden und lässt Vanessa daher nicht nur einmal sitzen. Außerdem bringt sie die Transschauspielerin Laverne Cox (Orange Is The New Black) auf die Idee, wieder an der Miss Universe teilzunehmen. Schließlich hat Jenna auch einen ersten Fotoshoot für eine PETA-Kampagne, für den sie ein sehr unkonventionelles Outfit tragen soll.

programme.title: Lakshmis Haus des Schicksals
programme.desc: Lakshmi Niwas ist ein gefühlvolles Familiendrama, das in einem traditionellen Haushalt spielt, in dem Beziehungen, Werte und Schicksal eng miteinander verbunden sind. Lakshmi ist eine starke und mitfühlende Frau, die zur emotionalen Stütze einer Familie wird, die von Liebe getragen, aber von Konflikten, Erwartungen und dem Wandel der Zeit herausgefordert wird. Während Generationen aufeinandertreffen und verborgene Wahrheiten ans Licht kommen, muss Lakshmi zwischen Pflicht, Opferbereitschaft und persönlichem Glück ihren eigenen Weg finden. Die Serie erzählt von Vertrauen, Zusammenhalt und der Bedeutung von Familie – Themen, die universell verständlich sind. Lakshmi Niwas ist eine Geschichte über Hoffnung, emotionale Bindungen und die stille Stärke einer Frau, die aus einem Haus ein Zuhause macht.

programme.title: Die Töchter der Mutter Ganga
programme.desc: Von ihrem Mann verstoßen, weil sie keinen Sohn zur Welt gebracht hat, erzieht die entschlossene Ganga ihre drei Töchter vor der Kulisse von Varanasi. Trotz Ungerechtigkeit und harten Lebensumständen werden ihre Erfolge Gangas größter Triumph.

programme.title: Humari Radha

programme.title: Vasudha

programme.title: Ram & Leela – Sehnsucht nach Liebe

programme.title: Du bist in meinem Herzen

Lakshmi ist eine starke und mitfühlende Frau, die zur emotionalen Stütze einer Familie wird, die von Liebe getragen, aber von Konflikten, Erwartungen und dem Wandel der Zeit herausgefordert wird. Während Generationen aufeinandertreffen und verborgene Wahrheiten ans Licht kommen, muss Lakshmi zwischen Pflicht, Opferbereitschaft und persönlichem Glück ihren eigenen Weg finden. Die Serie erzählt von Vertrauen, Zusammenhalt und der Bedeutung von Familie – Themen, die universell verständlich sind. Lakshmi Niwas ist eine Geschichte über Hoffnung, emotionale Bindungen und die stille Stärke einer Frau, die aus einem Haus ein Zuhause macht.

Das Mangalitza-Schwein war bis in die 70er Jahre fast ein Wahrzeichen Ungarns, verschwand dann von den Speisekarten und ist erst seit einem Jahrzehnt zurück. Jährlich verarbeitet die Familie 100 Tiere zu Salami und schleust nebenbei Touristengruppen durch den Hof.

programme.desc: Die deutsche Ostseeküste ist von der Halbinsel Fischland-Darß-Zingst bis hinüber nach Rügen eine einzigartige Küstenlandschaft, mit verträumt-schönen Landschaften und Dörfern und einer einzigartigen Vogelwelt. Ein Sehnsuchtsort für Mensch und Tier. Jedes Jahr im Herbst machen hier Zehntausende Kraniche Rast auf ihrem Weg in den Süden. GEO Reportage war den Kranichen auf der Spur.

programme.title: Schweizer Flussgeschichten
programme.desc: Hoch oben im Engadin entspringt der Inn – einer der mächtigsten Alpenflüsse – und bahnt sich seinen Weg durch glitzernde Seen, weite Täler und spektakuläre Schluchten. Mal gezähmt, mal wild ist er Lebensraum für Mensch, Tier und Pflanze. Auf rund 100 Kilometern durchquert er die Schweiz, bevor er über Österreich bis zur Donau fließt. Ein Fluss voller Kontraste, Kulturen und Geschichten – vom Ursprung bis zum Schwarzen Meer.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten, Herbst

Bei ihm wird Service noch groß geschrieben, er repariert Elektrogeräte auch schon mal auf Kulanz, sehr zum Leidwesen seines Chefs (Karl Kranzkowski). Doch Rüdigers normales Leben ändert sich schlagartig, als er durch Zufall auf der Straße für einen Werbespot entdeckt wird. Plötzlich ist Rüdiger das was heutzutage fast jeder sein will: Berühmt. Und auf einmal ist alles anders: Rüdigers ambitionierter Verkäufer-Kollege Jürgen (Florian Lukas) möchte unbedingt sein Manager werden, seine Frau hätte gern ein neues Auto, und die Werbeagentur erwartet von ihm vollen Einsatz. Eigentlich nur eine Frage der Zeit, bis Rüdiger völlig aus der Bahn geworfen wird ...

programme.title: Der kleine Mann
programme.desc: Wie jedes Jahr will Rüdiger zum Geburtstag seiner Frau eigenhändig Lammgulasch kochen. Doch Silvia lässt durchblicken, dass sie sich von ihrem jetzt berühmten Mann in diesem Jahr mehr versprochen hätte. Auf Anraten von Jürgen reserviert Rüdiger also einen Tisch im Restaurant des bekannten Fernsehkochs Alfie Ziegler (Georg Friedrich). Doch die Reservierung geht verloren, und alle Versuche Rüdigers, durch seine neue Prominenz doch noch einen Tisch zu ergattern, scheitern. Der Abend endet beinah in einer Fast Food Kette, wo Rüdiger dann allerdings erkannt wird. Nicht nur vom Personal, sondern überraschend auch von Alfie Ziegler und Sarah Wiener (Sarah Wiener). Jetzt nimmt Silvias Geburtstag eine unerwartete Wende, die dazu führt, dass Rüdiger vielleicht bald ein Dritte-Welt-Kochbuch herausbringen könnte ...

programme.title: Der kleine Mann
programme.desc: Mona, eine junge, attraktive Frau, taucht bei Rüdiger im Elektroladen auf. Sie kennt ihn angeblich von einer privaten Party, macht ihm Komplimente und überredet ihn schließlich zu einem gemeinsamen Abend in einer Bar, sehr zum Ärger von Silvia, die in Mona sofort ein Promiluder wittert. Rüdiger will das nicht wahrhaben und verbringt einen munteren Partyabend mit Mona, in dessen Verlauf sie ihm allerdings gesteht, dass sie in der Tat auf Rüdiger abfährt, weil er im Fernsehen ist. Das tut dem Spaß allerdings keinen Abbruch. Rüdiger ist entschlossen, sich auch weiterhin mit Mona zu treffen. Die Lage spitzt sich zu, als die Werbeagentur für einen neuen Spot eine attraktive Frau sucht und Jürgen sofort Mona ins Spiel bringt. Jetzt hängt der Haussegen bei den Bunzens endgültig schief. Allerdings reagiert Silvia mit einer überraschenden neuen Taktik: Sie versucht es mit Mona aufzunehmen ...

programme.title: Spitzname und andere Frivolitäten
programme.desc: Die Cheers-Truppe hat durch einen Kollegen von Frasier Informationen über Rebecca erhalten: Rebeccas Spitznamen zu ihrer Studienzeit waren ,,Partyhase Nummer eins" und ,,Backseat-Becky".

programme.title: Die Wohltätigkeitsveranstaltung
programme.desc: Frasier und Lilith verbringen einen romantischen Abend miteinander. Tollpatsch Frasier bringt es jedoch fertig, die Stimmung zu zerstören: Er erklärt seiner Gattin in spe, dass er einen Ehevertrag aufsetzen wolle. Wütend verlässt Lilith das Cheers.

programme.title: Woody als Mark Twain
programme.desc: Woody hegt schon seit langem den Wunsch, Schauspieler zu werden. Er spricht oft vor, wird aber abgelehnt. Da verspricht ihm der Regisseur, dass er im Falle eines Ausfalls einspringen könnte.

programme.title: Der Alibimann
programme.desc: Rebecca hat ein Problem: Ihr Chef Drake, den sie heimlich anhimmelt, hält sie für eine Lesbe. Um ihn vom Gegenteil zu überzeugen, muss sie in männlicher Begleitung zu Drakes Party erscheinen. Sam bietet sich unverbindlich an.

programme.title: Professor Clavin
programme.desc: Cliff hat sich verliebt. Seine Angebetete Sally ist eine graue Maus. Cliff würde jedoch gerne mit seiner neuen Freundin angeben. So verwandelt sie sich unter seiner Anleitung zu einer schönen Frau. Nun interessieren sich auf einmal etliche Männer für sie.

programme.title: Sam als Weihnachtsmann
programme.desc: Die Mitarbeiter vom Cheers sind sauer auf Rebecca. Sie hat alle für den Heiligabend zum Dienst eingeteilt. Dennoch haben alle, außer Sam, ein Weihnachtsgeschenk für die strenge Chefin besorgt. Nun versucht Sam, schleunigst ein Präsent aufzutreiben.

programme.title: Affentheater
programme.desc: Norman und Cliff haben sich böse verkracht. Es scheint, als würden sie nicht mehr zueinander finden. Rebecca vermietet das Hinterzimmer an einen Buchclub. Es stört sie nicht, dass sie den Männern damit ihren gewohnten Billardabend streitig macht.

programme.title: Scherben bringen Glück
programme.desc: Rebecca richtet eine Cocktailparty für ihren Chef aus. Sam und Woody beschwatzen sie so lange, bis Rebecca die beiden als Barkeeper anheuert. Bei der Party geht eine kostbare Vase zu Bruch.

programme.title: Die Aushilfskellnerin
programme.desc: Carla hat ihre Zwillinge zur Welt gebracht, was zu kurzfristigen Kellnerproblemen an der Bar führt.

programme.title: Geheimnisse des Meeres
programme.desc: Evan Drake, Besitzer des Cheers, lädt Sam und Rebecca zu einem Wochenende auf seiner Yacht ein. Um sich die Seereise zu versüßen, nimmt Sam noch eine Freundin mit. Alle freuen sich auf den romantischen Segeltörn. Das Meer birgt so einige Überraschungen.

programme.title: Ein Traumpaar
programme.desc: Vor seiner Hochzeit mit Lilith geben die Männer vom Cheers eine Party für Frasier. Während der Party entscheidet Frasier, dass er noch nicht bereit ist, seine Freiheit für eine Frau zu opfern. Er ruft Lilith an.

programme.title: Der Schlaf des Gerechten
programme.desc: Norm hat durch Rebeccas Vermittlung einen Auftrag bekommen: Er soll das Haus von Evan Drake, dem Besitzer des "Cheers", streichen. Für Rebecca ist das die Gelegenheit, sich ungestört die Gemächer ihres Angebeteten anzuschauen.

programme.title: Angst vorm Fliegen
programme.desc: Carlas Mann Eddie hat endlich eine Stellung gefunden: Er geht mit einer Eis-Revue auf Tournee. Weil Carla Flugangst hat, kann sie Eddie nicht hinterher reisen. So unternimmt Frasier mit ihr ein Anti-Flugangst-Seminar.

programme.title: Sam im grauen Flanellanzug
programme.desc: Evan Drake, Besitzer des ,,Cheers", hat Sam einen Führungsposten in seinem Konzern angeboten. Grund für die Anstellung sind ausschließlich Sams Fähigkeiten als Baseballspieler. Doch Sam sieht sich am Anfang einer großen Karriere.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Nach 300 Jahren unfreiwilligen Kälteschlafes wird Captain Dylan Hunt, Commander des Raumschiffes Andromeda, mit einer ihm völlig fremden Welt konfrontiert: Die Vereinigung der Planeten, in deren Auftrag er unterwegs war, existiert nicht mehr. Statt dessen herrscht Krieg und Chaos. Captain Dylan Hunt und eine bunt zusammengewürfelte Raumschiffcrew setzen alles daran, wieder Ordnung zu schaffen und die galaxisweite Kooperation der Planeten zu erneuern - ein äußerst gefährliches Unternehmen!
